tweet.text:
your LLM judge agrees with your human labels 95% of the time. so does return "pass".

1000 traces, 50 real fails:
always-pass judge: 95% agreement, catches 0
decent judge: 96% agreement, catches 40

report recall on the fails. agreement mostly measures your base rate.
